verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a project-management SaaS like Shortcut, so the axis applies. The pack shows no documented export or offboarding feature. The REST API is only a developer building block a user could script an export from. The import paths (Jira, Trello, CSV) bring data in, not out. The pricing line about accessing workspace data is too vague to count as a full-data export in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
